t: Wreaths are very versatile. With a wreath, you can place it as-is, use it on a Lamp Post, or combine it other blocks such as Doors and Picket Fence Gates to decorate them.$(br2)They come in three styles: $(li)Plain $(li)White Lights $(li)Multicolored Lights
花环用途极为广泛。你既可直接放置花环，也可将其用于灯柱，或与木门、尖桩篱栅门等方块组合以作装饰。$(br2)花环共分三种样式：$(li)素色款 $(li)白色灯款 $(li)多彩灯款
To craft a wreath, you'll need 8 Spruce Leaves and a Bow.
要合成花环，你需要8个云杉树叶和一张弓。
Once you have your wreath, you can give it an extra pop with some lights.$(br2)To make a lit wreath, combine a wreath with Tree Lights of your choice in a crafting table:
